title: Charles and Drew's electrostatic thrust experiments: thrust continues after unplugging

plain: The claim is that an electrostatic thruster, a device meant to push using electric charge instead of fuel, was powered up in a researcher's lab and then kept producing thrust indefinitely after it was unplugged from the wall. The lab belongs to a researcher named Charles Buhler, who did the experiments with a colleague called Drew, inside a Faraday cage (a metal enclosure that shuts out outside electrical fields) and a vacuum chamber. A theoretical physicist named David Chester, a friend of Michels who trained at MIT and UCLA and was brought onto the show to test Buhler's claims, sets the claim out on air and starts to answer it with 'well, you know, obviously'. If it held up, it would mean a device getting push out of nowhere.
